Explain the example for install an offline page

blocks.text: The install event is a chance to prepare files for later use. waitUntil keeps the install job open while those files are saved.

These examples belong in separate files on your own HTTPS or localhost site. Service workers need that trusted origin and cannot run in this site's sandbox. Use browser developer tools to inspect them.
Read the code step by step

items: `addEventListener` waits for the named event before calling the function you pass to it.
`waitUntil` tells the browser to keep this worker event active until the promise finishes.
`caches.open` opens a named Cache Storage collection. Choose versioned names that your app can manage safely.

blocks.text: The worker stores a real offline.html page in the named cache during installation.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Every file in addAll must load successfully. A missing offline.html can make installation fail.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Create offline.html with a short offline message.
